title: Porto to Palma
titleCardNarration: A week, four cities, two countries: from the Atlantic to the Mediterranean.

stops.name: Porto
stops.notes: Tiled houses stacked above the river Douro.
stops.narration: We started in Porto, where tiled houses climb the hills above the river Douro.

stops.name: Salamanca
stops.notes: Golden sandstone, lit up after dark.
stops.narration: Across the border into Spain, Salamanca's Plaza Mayor glows gold when the lights come on.
stops.travelNarration: East over the border, from the Atlantic into Spain.

stops.name: Madrid
stops.notes: A long evening in the Plaza Mayor.
stops.narration: And Madrid to finish: a long, slow evening in the Plaza Mayor.
stops.travelNarration: By train, south-east to the capital.

stops.name: Palma
stops.notes: La Seu, the cathedral above the sea.
stops.narration: And Palma to finish: La Seu, the cathedral that rises straight out of the sea wall.
stops.travelNarration: A short flight out over the Mediterranean to Mallorca.
stops.closureNarration: And that was Spain: from the border to the sea.
